jess: Short repro: samplekit JS in json_mode fails schema validation when an auth refresh triggers a retry mid-stream. Seen on-prem QA twice this week.
samir: can you paste minimal steps?
jess: steps: 1) start samplekit generate with `json_mode: true` and a streaming tool that emits JSON array elements 2) force token expiry mid-stream (simulate refresh) 3) SDK retries the stream and the stitcher naively concatenates replayed fragments resulting in `][` and parse error.

jess: logs:
```
INFO stream chunk 3: "
]"
WARN auth: token expired, refreshing token
INFO retrying stream request
INFO stream chunk 4 (replay): "[
{"id":1,"val":42}
"
ERROR schema-validator: unexpected token at position 1
```

maya: that looks like the stitcher kept previous buffer then appended the replayed prefix. The parser sees `][` and dies.
andre: current stitcher just does `buffer += chunk` and tries `JSON.parse` when it sees newline boundaries. No replay detection.
samir: two action items: short-term tolerant parse (strip stray leading/trailing separators when json_mode) and long-term stream-session-id + chunk-index to detect replays.
jess: agreed. also emit an EVENT when a retry happens so logs annotate that stream was restarted.
maya: i'll add a unit test for sdk-js that simulates: initial stream sends `"[
{"a":1}
` then replay sends `"[
{"b":2}
` and assert assembled final array is `[{a":1},{"b":2}]` (i'll write proper asserts) not `[{"a":1}][{"b":2}]`.
andre: i'll prototype stitcher change: if header `x-stream-retry: 1` present, reset buffer before consuming chunks; also defensively trim leading `]` or trailing `[` before parsing. will open PR.
samir: please also run the same test across py/ts SDKs; parity bug is likely.
jess: i've created issue #4456 with logs and QA repro env (assigned: andre + maya). i'll add troubleshooting note to samplekit README about auth-refresh during streaming.
devx-bot: created issue #4456: "sdk-js: streaming json_mode - auth-refresh retry causes invalid fragment concatenation"

jess: thanks all, i'll attach failing CI run to the issue.
maya: will push test + docs tweak tomorrow AM.
andre: aiming PR by EOD to add session header + stitcher guard.
samir: follow-up: consider switching streaming structured output to length-prefixed framing to avoid any ambiguity with separators.
jess: noted, adding framing discussion to the issue checklist.
